Compositional Wrappers (Require children.description: These templates require React elements (children) as props. They are internal composable primitives, not standalone scenes. They cannot be executed generically via JSON without a specialized layout orchestration adapter.
Compositional Wrappers (Require children.recommendedAction: Leave as CATALOG_ONLY (Internal Primitives) or build a mega Layout Adapter.

Scalar UI Primitives (Generic Fix Opport.description: These templates only require simple scalar props (label, name, value, to). They were blocked because the semantic generic mapper didn't know how to map CreativeSpec's headline/body_text to them.
Scalar UI Primitives (Generic Fix Opport.recommendedAction: Generic Fix (Update SemanticContentResolver to map headline -> label/name/value/to).

Complex Data UI (Specialized Families).description: These templates require arrays of complex objects (items, messages, columns, actions, keyframes). They can be grouped into an App UI Simulation family.
Complex Data UI (Specialized Families).recommendedAction: Build a specialized family adapter (e.g. app_ui_simulation_v1).

Media Mapping Blockers (Generic Fix Oppo.description: Templates blocked by MISSING_MEDIA_MAPPING. They require media assets but lack semantic mapping.
Media Mapping Blockers (Generic Fix Oppo.recommendedAction: Generic Fix (Map asset requirements to CreativeSpec media slots).

Dependency Blockers.description: Templates blocked by missing physical dependencies (e.g., missing video files).

True Singletons.description: Templates with highly unique structural requirements (orchestrators).
True Singletons.recommendedAction: Build specialized singleton adapters or leave as CATALOG_ONLY.
